og_image_alt: A solved Hashiwokakero puzzle in pixel art: numbered islands joined by wooden and vermilion bridges

ld.site: Hashiwokakero, the Japanese bridges puzzle, playable for free in the browser.
ld.game: Connect the islands with bridges so that every island has as many bridges as its number says. A daily puzzle with a leaderboard, five difficulties, pixel art, and every puzzle has exactly one solution.
